example.title: Nimrod Bridge (Wallace Bridge), County Road 18 over the Fourche LaFave River

brief: Single-span, ten-panel pin-connected camelback (Parker family) through truss, 180 ft span and 222 ft overall with a short steel-stringer approach at each end, on concrete-filled steel cylinder piers. Upper chord of five straight segments rising from 17.5 ft at the portals to 26 ft at mid-span; laced built-up chords and posts, forged eyebar lower chords, loop-ended rod diagonals with turnbuckle counters in the four centre panels; trusses 17 ft apart with a 15 ft roadway of transverse timber planks with running boards on wood stringers, and a plain steel rail along each side. Crosses a slow, tree-lined river on a gravel county road (Southwestern Bridge Co. fabricator; measured drawings included).
